sources.document_title: WS2812B-2020-V6 Intelligent control LED integrated light source
sources.locator: Page 1: title block (WORLDSEMI logo, part name WS2812B-2020-V6), Features and Benefits section, footer
sources.evidence_extract: Title block: WORLDSEMI logo, "WS2812B-2020-V6 Intelligent control LED integrated light source"; footer http://www.world-semi.com, V1.4. Features: working current for each channel is 12mA; send data at speeds of 800Kbps; reverse power connection will not cause damage; static power consumption is below 1uA; 3.3 V power supply is supported. A5 recorded sha256 b09737faa695f6acca16612d3da658da6692fbf4366047083dad84809d452bca (2026-11-05/06, source_provenance.json id WORLDSEMI) for https://www.world-semi.com/downloads/datasheets/en/ws2812b-2020-v6-1.0.pdf; bytes inspected now (2026-11-08): b09737faa695f6acca16612d3da658da6692fbf4366047083dad84809d452bca - identical. Despite the v1.0 URL the bytes are revision V1.4 (every page footer and the Modify Record table, V1.4 dated 20260728). Image-only PDF: values read visually from rendered pages. Re-observed 2026-11-11 through the owner's built-in browser: the same URL served the same sha256 (1264070 bytes, Last-Modified Thu, 10 Sep 2026 02:28:58 GMT), so V1.4 is still the revision served there; no later revision was found on world-semi.com (the /downloads/ index returns 403).

sources.locator: Page 3: PIN Function table (rows 1 to 4), Absolute Maximum Ratings table (rows VDD, VI, Topt) and Electrical Characteristics table (rows VIH, VIL)
sources.evidence_extract: PIN Function: 1 DO DATA OUT; 2 GND GROUND; 3 DI DATA IN; 4 VDD POWER SUPPLY. Absolute Maximum Ratings (TA=25C, VSS=0V): power supply voltage VDD +3.3~+5.3 V; logical input voltage VI -0.3V~VDD+0.7 V; working temperature -40~+85 C. Electrical Characteristics (TA=25C, VDD=5V): VIH min 0.55VDD, max VDD+0.7V; VIL min -0.3V, max 0.7V (DIN, SET). Switching: FMAX data transmission rate min 600 Kbps.
